newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN LOSING STEAM AFTER SURGE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN LOSING STEAM AFTER SURGE.

text.p: Polish shares were seen slowing their growth or falling in profit-taking on Monday after last week's 6.4-percent surge to 15,418.9 points.

Analysts said a continuation of last week's apparent foreign buying might then spur more rises, with investors watching Wednesday's December inflation figure to see if the central bank will raise interest rates, as it warned it might.
Analysts said 15,000 points would likely provide support.
On Monday Indykpol transfers to the main market from the bourse's parallel floor.
